name: gyandistro
description: GyanDistro — a MERN + TypeScript blogging platform with roles, moderation, AI assistance and built-in monetisation.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
